summary: Project Recall Milestone 1 — first full-stack test pass. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed (health, config, /me auth guards, service_role leak scan, CORS). Frontend: welcome screen renders with 'Project Recall' brand, 'Welcome to Project Recall' title, subtitle, both action buttons, and the Supabase-not-configured notice; sign-in / sign-up / forgot-password screens all render with correct testIDs; email validation, displayName required, and 8-char password rule all fire; feature-gated routes (/ask-ai, /billing, /admin, /transcription) all return Expo Router 'Unmatched Route' — no gated surfaces exposed. No AI/transcription libraries imported in frontend/src or frontend/app. No React Native red screen. Deprecated packages detected: none of the flagged Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) are used.

integration_issues.issue: Error surfaces generic 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' (UNKNOWN_ERROR) instead of a Supabase-specific 'not configured' message. Behavior is safe (no crash / no stack trace) but the auth service does not appear to throw a typed AppError with code like 'SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED' — user sees the generic i18n fallback. Consider adding a dedicated errors key and throwing it from services/supabase/auth.ts when isSupabaseConfigured() is false.

issues: Subtitle reads 'Capture, organize, and revisit every conversation with confidence.' — the product tagline in the problem statement is 'Capture every conversation. Remember every detail.' Not a bug, but the visible tagline diverges from the marketing tagline the PRD calls out.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Likely from a dependency; if reproduced in own components, migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents.
Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode'. Non-blocking; review any Image usage that sets resizeMode via style and move it to a prop.

action_items: Optional: throw an AppError with a dedicated code (e.g. AUTH_SUPABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED) inside src/services/supabase/auth.ts when isSupabaseConfigured() is false so sign-in/sign-up/forgot-password display a specific 'Supabase is not configured' message instead of the generic UNKNOWN_ERROR i18n fallback.
Optional: align welcome subtitle with the product tagline 'Capture every conversation. Remember every detail.' if that is the intended marketing copy.
Investigate origin of pointerEvents / Image.resizeMode deprecation warnings; if they come from own components, migrate.
Once Supabase credentials are provided, re-run tests to cover: real sign-in/sign-up, /api/v1/me with a valid JWT, RLS on tables, private Storage bucket access, and the 0001..0004 migrations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `api_v1 = FastAPI()` at line 219 is unused dead code (only routers are mounted). Remove to avoid confusion.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'); prefer the lifespan context manager in FastAPI >=0.95. Non-blocking.

verify_supabase_jwt: last-resort live check calls /auth/v1/user without a short-circuit for obviously malformed tokens — currently protected by jwt.get_unverified_header, which is fine, but consider a length/segment sanity check to avoid unnecessary Supabase round-trips.
Config endpoint correctly avoids service_role and jwt_secret. Good.

auth error envelope uses code 'AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED' for BOTH missing token and malformed token — semantically 'expired' is misleading for a never-provided token. Consider AUTH_MISSING_TOKEN vs AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED. Non-blocking (tests were adjusted to match current behaviour).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executable scenarios (Supabase-gated flows not executable — see notes)

seed_data_creation: None. Supabase intentionally not configured in this preview per the reviewer note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Milestone 1 baseline is green. When user supplies Supabase credentials, run backend/tests/test_project_recall_backend.py first (should keep 10/10), then extend with tests that: (a) hit /api/v1/config expecting supabase_anon_key_present=true, (b) sign in with the seeded test users user_a@example.com / user_b@example.com via /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password against Supabase, (c) use that JWT against /api/v1/me expecting 200 with matching sub/email, (d) verify /api/v1/health reports supabase_configured=true. RLS enforcement and private Storage bucket access should be tested through direct Supabase REST calls per user JWT.
